convert_regnet_to_mmdet: run the python module to convert pycls pretrained RegNet model keys to mmdet style
convert_stem_keys: create a function that converts stem layer keys from pycls format to mmdet conv1 and bn1 naming
convert_head_keys: create a function that converts head layer keys from pycls head.fc format to mmdet fc naming
convert_reslayer_keys: build a function that converts residual layer keys including downsample, bn, and conv modules to mmdet style
review_convert_function: review the python convert function that loads a RegNet model, transforms all keys, and saves the checkpoint
